summary: Stream buffer read state dispatcher. Sets up a state object when its discriminator is not the expected initial value, then advances a read position through a dispatch-object callback until the buffer is exhausted, at which point it signals completion through the state object vtable and returns 0.

operations.description: if this+0x10 != 205 the state object is not in the expected initial state, so initialize it
write state code 18 into obj+0x14 (via this+0x0) marking active processing
copy the source discriminator this+0x10 into obj+0x18 for tracking
invoke state-object vtable slot 0 (obj+0x0) with this as argument
if read position this+0x78 < buffer size this+0x60, more data is available to read
if secondary callback object this+0x8 is non-null, prime it with current read state
write read position this+0x78 and buffer size this+0x60 into the callback object at +4 and +8
invoke callback-object vtable slot 0 (this+0x8) with this as argument
invoke dispatch-object vtable slot 1 (this+0x180 plus 4) with (this, a2, address of out-pointer, a3); result is returned through the out-pointer
advance read position this+0x78 by the byte count returned through the out-pointer
buffer exhausted: set obj+0x14 = 119 (done) and invoke completion handler at obj+0x4 with (this, -1)
return the out-pointer result from the read branch, or 0 from the done branch
